attributes.description: Nalwa Sons Investments Ltd (NSIL) is an RBI-registered, non-deposit-taking NBFC–Middle Layer that holds strategic investments, mainly in O.P. Jindal-group companies, and lends to group companies. Consolidated accounts also include a small goods-trading activity.[1]
